mundaka_chapter5_verse5.title: Mundaka Chapter 5 Verse 5
mundaka_chapter5_verse5.introduction: This verse belongs to Mundaka, Chapter 5.
mundaka_chapter5_verse5.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Mundaka Upanishad, Chapter 5, Verse 5, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
mundaka_chapter5_verse5.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
